description.value: Left Field Cider Co. is a family-owned artisanal cidery making handcrafted English-style cider from blends of English, French, and BC dessert apples. Founded in 2011 by sisters Theresa and Kate on their family ranch at Mamette Lake, they converted a hayfield into an orchard and a barn into a ciderhouse. The tasting room is located on Hwy 97C between Merritt and Logan Lake, offering a seasonal stop for passing cyclists in BC's Interior.
